verdict.rationale: pnpm's own docs show JSON output only for the audit command ("Output audit report in JSON format."). The pack has no evidence of JSON output for other core commands such as install, list, outdated, licenses, or the dry-run install report. missing for 10: documented JSON output across core commands (install/list/outdated/why/licenses), a stable machine-readable schema, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent parsing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get machine-readable (JSON) output from core commands so an agent can parse results instead of scraping text

citations.quote: Output audit report in JSON format.
